title: Notice of Adverse Benefit Determination
paragraphs: We reviewed the claim submitted by Summitview Family Medicine under your health plan for services provided on September 15, 2026. After review, we are unable to approve payment.
Your plan has reached its annual benefit limit for this type of service, so this claim is not covered. Reason code: CO-96.
The plan paid $0.00 of the $3,582.37 billed. The amount you may owe the provider is $3,582.37.

appeal.heading: Your Right to Appeal
appeal.text: Your written appeal must be received by March 30, 2027. Send it to Ostrander Mutual Health, Appeals Unit, PO Box 41211, Orlando, FL 32801. If waiting for a standard decision could seriously harm your health, you may ask for an expedited appeal by calling 1-800-555-1272.
appeal.external: After the internal appeal, you may have the right to an independent external review. Free help is available from your state's consumer assistance program.
